skill.summary: MacBook system optimization, performance monitoring, and troubleshooting tools for macOS users.

latestVersion.changelog:
Major update: Complete overhaul with new features, GUI-first workflows, and enhanced automation.

- Now works on all Macs (Intel & Apple Silicon) using only built-in macOS tools—no extra installation required.
- Added GUI-first experience: opens Activity Monitor, System Settings, and Finder automatically for visual workflows.
- Expanded features: automated cleanup, startup optimization, network monitoring, visual reports, and actionable recommendations.
- Introduced intelligent automation for safe cleanup, step-by-step fixes, and ongoing monitoring (optional).
- Stronger privacy and safety: always seeks confirmation before making changes and never sends data externally.
- User-friendly design with plain language instructions, emoji status indicators, and visual summaries.
